lines.en: label karindate10:
I tap on Karin’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Karin 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: scene black
scene karinthirddate1
I show up at the park to find Karin dressed a bit differently than normal.
lines.zh: 我到了公园，发现 Karin 穿得跟平时不太一样。

lines.en: This is the first time she's worn her casual clothes to a meet-up, and I have to say they suit her really well.
lines.zh: 这是她第一次穿便服来赴约，我得说，这一身真的很适合她。

lines.en: She stands nervously before me, saying nothing and just looking off to the side, waiting for me to take the lead.
lines.zh: 她紧张地站在我面前，一句话也不说，只是把视线偏到一边，等着我先开口。

lines.en: Which I’m fine with, of course. It’s just a vast departure from how I’ve seen her act on the soccer field.
lines.zh: 我当然无所谓。只是这跟我在足球场上见过的她，判若两人。

lines.en: But then again, the soccer field is filled with females and I have a penis.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，足球场上全是女生，而我有根鸡巴。

lines.en: So it goes.
lines.zh: 就是这么回事。

lines.en: : Are you not planning on running today?
lines.zh: : 你今天不打算跑了吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate2
: Oh, umm, I...went for a run earlier. So I thought that it would be fine to just...you know, {i}not{/i} run today.
lines.zh: : 哦，呃，我……之前跑过了。所以我想今天……就，你知道的，{i}不{/i}跑了也行。

lines.en: : I’m not keeping you from hanging out with your friends, am I?
lines.zh: : 我没耽误你跟朋友出去玩吧？

lines.en: : I know you and your sister are normally out and about, so sorry if you feel obligated to waste any of that time on me.
lines.zh: : 我知道你平时总和妹妹在外面逛，要是你觉得非得把那点时间浪费在我身上，那我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate3
: What?! N-No! It's not a waste at all!
lines.zh: : 什么？！才、才不是！一点都不算浪费！

lines.en: : I’m totally free today. All day. And if you’re worried about me falling behind on practice or anything then-
lines.zh: : 我今天完全有空。一整天都有空。你要是担心我落下训练什么的，那——

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m definitely not worried about that. You practice more than anyone.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这个我绝对不担心。你比谁练得都多。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate4
: R-Right...
lines.zh: : 也、也是……

lines.en: Karin nervously fidgets with her hands behind her back, digging one of her sneakers into the ground and tracing a circle with it.
lines.zh: Karin 紧张地在背后绞着双手，一只运动鞋蹭着地面，画出一个圈。

lines.en: It’s a lopsided circle- one that would cause problems in art class.
lines.zh: 那是个歪歪扭扭的圈——在美术课上是要出问题的那种。

lines.en: : Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate3
: Nothing is wrong! Everything is great! Super great!
lines.zh: : 什么都没出！一切都很好！超级好！

lines.en: : I’m not hiding anything behind my back!
lines.zh: : 我背后什么都没藏！

lines.en: : I didn’t say you were hiding anything behind your back.
lines.zh: : 我又没说你背后藏了什么。

lines.en: : Good! Because I’m not!
lines.zh: : 那就好！因为我确实没藏！

lines.en: : I’m starting to think you are.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你藏了。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate5
: OKAYFINEHEREYOUGO!
lines.zh: : 好吧好吧给你就是了！

lines.en: Karin stretches her arms out and holds a bright pink bag several inches from my face.
lines.zh: Karin 伸出双臂，把一只亮粉色的袋子举到我面前几英寸的地方。

lines.en: It’s easy to see how much her hands are shaking due to how close she is.
lines.zh: 她离得这么近，手抖得有多厉害，一眼就能看出来。

lines.en: This is obviously the first time she’s ever given some sort of gift to a guy but...what is it exactly?
lines.zh: 这显然是她第一次送男生什么东西，不过……这到底是什么？

lines.en: : What is this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate6
: Cookies...
lines.zh: : 饼干……

lines.en: : I made...extra. And I thought you might want some.
lines.zh: : 我……做多了。想着你可能想要一些。

lines.en: : But if not I’ll just throw them into the river.
lines.zh: : 要是不要的话，我就扔河里去。

lines.en: : There’s no need to throw anything into the river, Karin...
lines.zh: : 没必要往河里扔什么东西，Karin……

lines.en: scene karinthirddate4
I take the bag from her and lightly shake it around a bit.
lines.zh: 我从她手里接过袋子，轻轻晃了晃。

lines.en: It feels like there’s a good amount in here. I highly doubt that she just happened to make {i}extra{/i}...
lines.zh: 感觉里面分量不少。我严重怀疑她只是“碰巧做{i}多{/i}了”……

lines.en: : You made these specifically for me, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 这些是你专门为我做的，对吧？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate7
: N-No! I made them for...my mom and dad!
lines.zh: : 不、不是！我是做给……我爸妈的！

lines.en: : But then I realized they were on a diet!
lines.zh: : 可后来我想起来他们在减肥！

lines.en: : And I suddenly had so many cookies and I thought to myself, “Who likes cookies?!”
lines.zh: : 然后我手里突然就多了这么多饼干，我就想，“谁喜欢饼干来着？！”

lines.en: : And then I thought of you!
lines.zh: : 然后我就想到你了！

lines.en: : N-Not because I was thinking about {i}you{/i} but because...E-Everyone likes cookies!
lines.zh: : 不、不是因为我在想{i}你{/i}，而是因为……每、每个人都喜欢饼干！

lines.en: scene karinthirddate8
: And that’s exactly what happened.
lines.zh: : 事情就是这样的。

lines.en: : Well, whatever the case, I’m very thankful for them. Can I have one now?
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎么说，我很感谢。我现在能吃一块吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate3
: Now?! No way! Wait until you get home!
lines.zh: : 现在？！不行！等你回家再吃！

lines.en: : They’re probably bad anyway!
lines.zh: : 反正大概也难吃得要命！

lines.en: : In fact, give them back to me. The river isn’t far away and-
lines.zh: : 其实你还给我吧。河离这儿又不远，而且——

lines.en: : I’ll just eat them tonight...Thanks.
lines.zh: : 我今晚再吃就是了……谢谢。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate9
: Hah...my heart feels like it’s going to explode and I didn’t even do any running today.
lines.zh: : 哈……我的心脏感觉要炸了，可我今天根本没跑步啊。

lines.en: : I thought you said you went running earlier?
lines.zh: : 你不是说你之前跑过了吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate4
: O-Oh! Right! Yes! That is exactly why my heart must be beating so fast. Definitely not because of anything else. Nope. Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 哦、哦！对！没错！所以我的心跳才会这么快。绝对不是因为别的什么。对。完全没有。

lines.en: : I mean, what would even be the cause of that?
lines.zh: : 我是说，还能有什么别的原因呢？

lines.en: : ...Do you really want me to say it?
lines.zh: : ……你真想让我说出来吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate10
: Please don’t...
lines.zh: : 求你别说……

lines.en: : I beg you...
lines.zh: : 我求你了……

lines.en: I decide to give Karin a break and not explain to her that she might just be a {i}little{/i} bit infatuated with me for some indiscernible reason.
lines.zh: 我决定放过 Karin，不跟她点明——她大概是出于某种说不清的原因，对我{i}有点{/i}着迷了。

lines.en: I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t impressed, though.
lines.zh: 不过要说我不感动，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: Hell, I can’t even remember the last time any of the other girls gave me a non-sexual present.
lines.zh: 说真的，我都想不起来上一次有哪个女孩送我一件跟性无关的礼物是什么时候了。

lines.en: Not to say that I wouldn’t accept something like that from Karin (I absolutely would) but cookies are still good.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我不愿意收 Karin 那种礼物（我绝对愿意），不过饼干也挺好。

lines.en: It must have been hard for her to give these to me.
lines.zh: 把这些交给我，对她来说一定很不容易。

lines.en: : Okay, so, I won’t eat your cookies now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我现在就不吃你的饼干了。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate1
: You can always...text me how they were later if you want to.
lines.zh: : 你可以……晚点发短信告诉我味道怎么样，如果你想的话。

lines.en: : I mean, it would obviously be a little weird for a grown man to text some random [teenager] but...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，一个成年男人给某个不相干的 [teenager] 发短信，显然是有点奇怪，可是……

lines.en: : You know...we’ve got phones so...we might as well use them, right? Hahahah...
lines.zh: : 你知道的……我们都有手机，所以……不如就用起来，对吧？哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : But anyway, what did you want to do today if you’re not going to be running?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，既然不跑步，你今天想做什么？

lines.en: : I-I don’t know!
lines.zh: : 我、我不知道！

lines.en: : If only there was...some sort of place that two people could go to kill time and...maybe eat dinner together...
lines.zh: : 要是能有个……那种两个人可以去消磨时间、还……可以一起吃晚饭的地方就好了……

lines.en: I feel like the last time I suggested something like that she ran away nearly crying.
lines.zh: 我记得上次我提类似的事，她几乎是哭着跑掉的。

lines.en: Has she really changed her mind about that already?
lines.zh: 她真的这么快就改主意了？

lines.en: : It’s very...unfortunate that a place like that doesn’t exist...right, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 那种地方居然不存在，真是太……遗憾了……对吧，老师？……

lines.en: : I wonder what else there is to do?...
lines.zh: : 还有别的事可做吗？……

lines.en: : Karin.
lines.zh: : Karin。

lines.en: : ...Yeah?
lines.zh: : ……怎么了？

lines.en: : Are you pretending to not know what a restaurant is?
lines.zh: : 你是在装作不知道餐厅是什么东西吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate11
: I-Is it...working?...
lines.zh: : 成、成功了吗？……

lines.en: : If you want to go out to eat, just say it.
lines.zh: : 你想出去吃，直说就行了。

lines.en: : There’s no point in trying to trick me into asking you out on a date.
lines.zh: : 没必要拐着弯儿让我开口约你。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate7
: MMMMMM! Don’t call it that!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯！别那么说！

lines.en: : It’s embarrassing...
lines.zh: : 太难为情了……

lines.en: : It’s just...I mean...what else are we going to do?
lines.zh: : 只是……我是说……我们还能干什么？

lines.en: : I didn’t bring my other clothes and...running without a sports bra on is kinda not something I want to do right now...
lines.zh: : 我没带换洗衣服，而且……不穿运动内衣跑步，我现在实在不太想……

lines.en: I can’t say I blame her. She’s rather...endowed for a girl her age.
lines.zh: 我不能怪她。以她这个年纪来说，她确实……很有料。

lines.en: : Well is there anywhere in particular you want to go? I still have some time before I have to leave tonight.
lines.zh: : 那你有特别想去的地方吗？今晚我还有点时间才走。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate10
: Oh...Umm, right...Of course you’d have stuff to do tonight. That’s fine...
lines.zh: : 哦……呃，也是……你今晚当然还有事要忙。没关系……

lines.en: : I’m sorry for expecting you to stay with me any longer. It’s obvious you’re busy and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我不该指望你再陪我久一点。你显然很忙，而且——

lines.en: : Hey, now. There’s no need to get all down on yourself. We can spend an entire day together sometime in the future.
lines.zh: : 嘿，行了。别把自己说得这么低落。以后我们总有机会一起待上一整天。

lines.en: : That...really does make it sound like...you know.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来真的很像……你知道的。

lines.en: : A date?
lines.zh: : 约会？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate12
: NGH!
Each time I insinuate something even slightly romantic or affectionate, Karin freezes up or cringes or does...anything else mildly comedic.
lines.zh: 每次我稍微暗示一点浪漫或者亲昵的东西，Karin 就会僵住、或者缩成一团，或者做出……别的什么有点滑稽的反应。

lines.en: With a sister like Kirin, I have no idea how she's able to act like this. It's the complete opposite personality.
lines.zh: 有个 Kirin 那样的妹妹，我真不明白她怎么会是这副样子。两人的性格完全相反。

lines.en: Just what the hell is going on with that family?
lines.zh: 那一家人到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’ll stop using the D-word.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我不再用那个 D 开头的词了。

lines.en: : D-WORD?! WHO SAID ANYTHING ABOUT THE D-WORD?!
lines.zh: : D 开头的词？！谁说 D 开头的词了？！

lines.en: : Karin, I think you might be thinking of a different D-word now.
lines.zh: : Karin，我觉得你现在想到的，可能是另一个 D 开头的词。

lines.en: : I’M NOT THINKING OF ANYTHING LIKE THAT. I DON’T EVEN KNOW ANY D-WORDS.
lines.zh: : 我才没有在想那种东西。我根本不知道什么 D 开头的词。

lines.en: : DOG? ARE YOU THINKING OF DOGS?
lines.zh: : 蛋糕？你在想蛋糕吗？

lines.en: : DOGS ARE GREAT, AREN’T THEY, SENSEI?
lines.zh: : 蛋糕很棒，对吧，老师？

lines.en: : AM I YELLING AGAIN?!
lines.zh: : 我是不是又在吼了？！

lines.en: : Do you have an inhaler or something? It looks like you’re having a little trouble breathing.
lines.zh: : 你有吸入器什么的吗？看你呼吸好像有点困难。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate10
: Talking to you makes my chest hurt...I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 跟你说话让我胸口疼……我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : And yet you continue to hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 可你还是继续跟我混在一起。

lines.en: : I even baked you cookies.
lines.zh: : 我甚至还给你烤了饼干。

lines.en: : I thought you baked those for your mom and dad?
lines.zh: : 你不是说烤给你爸妈的吗？

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : But you just said-
lines.zh: : 可你刚才说——

lines.en: : No I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我没说过。

lines.en: : Okay. Let’s just find somewhere nearby and get something to eat since you’ve apparently never been to a restaurant before.
lines.zh: : 好吧。既然你显然从没去过餐厅，我们就在附近找点东西吃吧。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate13
: Y-Yeah! Let’s d-d-d-d-do that! That sounds really f-f-f-f-f-f-f-f-
lines.zh: : 好、好！那我们就去、去、去、去吧！听起来真的非、非、非、非、非——

lines.en: : Just let me do the talking, okay?
lines.zh: : 你让我来点单就好，好吗？

lines.en: scene black
Karin and I walk through the streets toward...well, anywhere.
lines.zh: Karin 和我穿过街道，走向……嗯，哪儿都行。

lines.en: She remains extremely tense the entire time.
lines.zh: 她全程都紧张得要命。

lines.en: And I mean extremely tense. It looks like every joint in her body has frozen up.
lines.zh: 我是说真的要命。她身上每个关节看起来都僵住了。

lines.en: But even though she’s struggling to maintain her composure, she follows gleefully alongside me and we eventually stop at a rather familiar place...
lines.zh: 不过尽管她拼命想维持镇定，还是高高兴兴地跟在我身边，最后我们在一个相当眼熟的地方停了下来……

lines.en: scene karinthirddate14
: So umm...cafes...am I right?
lines.zh: : 那个呃……咖啡馆……是吧？

lines.en: : Well, you are right in noticing that this is a cafe. Good job.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你没看错，这确实是家咖啡馆。干得好。

lines.en: : I have to apologize in advance for something, though.
lines.zh: : 不过有件事我得先跟你道个歉。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate15
: Apologize?! Did I do something wrong?!
lines.zh: : 道歉？！我做错什么了吗？！

lines.en: : It’s too soon for us to go somewhere like this together, isn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 我们两个这么快来这种地方，还是太早了吧？！

lines.en: : I had no idea! I’m still really bad at this...I-I...I’ll do more research! I swear!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！我对这种事还是很不熟练……我、我……我会多做功课的！我发誓！

lines.en: : No, no. It’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 不不，不是那回事。

lines.en: : There’s just one of my students here right now and I’m pretty sure that the two of us are going to be grilled in a matter of seconds.
lines.zh: : 只是我有个学生现在在这儿，我很确定几秒钟之内我们俩就要被审问了。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate16
: For being seen together?...
lines.zh: : 因为我们被看到在一起？……

lines.en: : Something like that...
lines.zh: : 差不多吧……

lines.en: scene karinthirddate17
: Oh...yeah. I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 哦……也是。抱歉……

lines.en: : Of course something like that would happen.
lines.zh: : 这种事当然会发生了。

lines.en: Frankly, I knew this was going to be a risk when the two of us came here.
lines.zh: 说实话，我们俩来这儿的时候我就知道会有这个风险。

lines.en: But I live for danger.
lines.zh: 但我为危险而生。

lines.en: Just kidding. I live for cute girls.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。我为可爱女孩而生。

lines.en: And I also want to see how Karin will act when she’s thrown into the fire.
lines.zh: 而且我也想看看，Karin 被扔进火坑里会是什么反应。

lines.en: Godspeed, co-captain.
lines.zh: 祝你好运，副队长。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate18
: Well, well, well...what do we have here?
lines.zh: : 哎呀哎呀……我们这儿有什么呢？

lines.en: : You bring a girl from our[school] into {i}my{/i} cafe? During {i}my{/i} shift?
lines.zh: : 你把我们[school]的女孩带到{i}我的{/i}咖啡馆来？还是在{i}我{/i}当班的时候？

lines.en: : Is this some sort of test? What's your game here, Sir?
lines.zh: : 这是某种考验吗？你打的什么算盘，先生？

lines.en: : Umm...Hey there. My name’s-
lines.zh: : 呃……你好。我叫——

lines.en: scene karinthirddate19
: SILENCE, WENCH!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，贱民！

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, okay. My bad...
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，好吧。我的错……

lines.en: scene karinthirddate20
: Sir. What is the meaning of this new character? How large is this pool of [young_girls] going to grow?!
lines.zh: : 先生。这个新角色是什么意思？这群 [young_girls] 的池子还要扩大到什么地步？！

lines.en: : How do you expect to develop all of them?! Focus on the ones you have first!
lines.zh: : 你打算怎么把她们全部培养起来？！先专心经营你手上这些吧！

lines.en: : Can’t you see what Ireland has to offer?! Can’t you see me?!
lines.zh: : 你难道看不见爱尔兰能给你什么吗？！你难道看不见我吗？！

lines.en: : Molly, this is Karin. She’s the co-captain of the[school] soccer team.
lines.zh: : Molly，这是 Karin。她是[school]足球队的副队长。

lines.en: : This does not explain why you two are chatting over tea and crumpets.
lines.zh: : 这解释不了你们俩为什么在喝茶吃司康、聊得正欢。

lines.en: : We haven’t even ordered anything yet.
lines.zh: : 我们还没点东西呢。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate21
: We were just...practicing in the park and worked up an appetite.
lines.zh: : 我们只是……在公园训练，然后就饿了。

lines.en: : Sensei recommended this place because of how much he likes it, so...I thought I’d give it a go too...
lines.zh: : 老师推荐了这家店，因为他很喜欢这里，所以……我想我也来试试……

lines.en: : Sorry if it seems like I’m intruding...
lines.zh: : 如果显得我像是不请自来，那抱歉了……

lines.en: How is Karin lying so naturally right now? I didn’t think she’d be the type to do something like that.
lines.zh: Karin 这谎撒得怎么这么自然？我没想到她会是干这种事的人。

lines.en: I don’t even need to think up an excuse now.
lines.zh: 这下我连借口都不用想了。

lines.en: This is great.
lines.zh: 太棒了。

lines.en: : Hmm...Well, at least you are polite.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，至少你还挺有礼貌。

lines.en: : But I have to say, I’m quite concerned by the size of your breasts.
lines.zh: : 不过我得说，你胸部的尺寸让我很担忧。

lines.en: : ...I'm sorry?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : What are they? Double D’s? Triples?! Explain yourself!
lines.zh: : 到底是多大？双 D？还是三倍？！给我解释清楚！

lines.en: : That’s...not something I’d like to discuss right now...
lines.zh: : 这个……我现在不太想讨论……

lines.en: : Tch!
: You well-endowed women are all the same. Never wanting to discuss your sizes and leaving us flat girls to ROT in MISERY!
lines.zh: : 你们这些有料的女人都是一个德行。从来不肯谈自己的尺寸，把咱们这些平胸的姑娘丢在痛苦里慢慢腐烂！

lines.en: scene karinthirddate22
: YOU WILL BURN FOR YOUR SINS! BOTH OF YOU!
lines.zh: : 你们会为自己的罪孽付出代价的！你们两个都是！

lines.en: scene karinthirddate23
: Yeah, so that’s what I was apologizing for.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这就是我刚才要道歉的事。

lines.en: : Molly doesn’t take too kindly to unexpected girls showing up and joining the harem.
lines.zh: : Molly 不太欢迎突然冒出来的女孩加入后宫。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate24
: Harem?!
lines.zh: : 后宫？！

lines.en: : That’s what she calls it at least. I think she wants to be recognized.
lines.zh: : 至少她是这么叫的。我觉得她只是想被认可罢了。

lines.en: : ...It was a joke.
lines.zh: : ……开玩笑的。

lines.en: It wasn’t.
lines.zh: 才不是。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate25
: Phew...
: Hearing that made me a lot more...umm...
lines.zh: : 听了那些，我感觉……更……呃……

lines.en: : Actually, never mind.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。

lines.en: : I never started that sentence.
lines.zh: : 那句话我根本没开头。

lines.en: : Agreed. You never started that sentence and we will do our best to avoid it coming up again in the future.
lines.zh: : 同意。那句话你确实没开头，我们以后也会尽量不让它再被提起。

lines.en: : So, are you ready to order?
lines.zh: : 那么，准备好点单了吗？

lines.en: scene karinthirddate26
: Oh! Almost! I just need a little more time to look at the menu if you don’t mind...
lines.zh: : 哦！快了！如果你不介意，我还需要一点时间看看菜单……

lines.en: : I’m surprisingly picky when it comes to food. I still cut the crusts off of my sandwiches and everything.
lines.zh: : 我在吃的东西上意外地挑剔。我到现在还会把三明治的硬边切掉什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t know why I’m telling you this. Please stop me before I continue to embarrass myself.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己为什么要跟你说这些。趁我还没继续丢人，快拦住我吧。

lines.en: : No, no. Please tell me more about how childish you are. It’s cute.
lines.zh: : 不不。请再多说说你有多孩子气。很可爱。

lines.en: scene karinthirddate27
: C-C-C-C-C-C-C-C!
lines.zh: : 可、可、可、可、可、可、可、可！

lines.en: scene black
Karin breaks again and takes a full five minutes to snap out of her cute-coma.
lines.zh: Karin 又坏掉了，足足花了五分钟才从她的“可爱昏迷”里缓过来。

lines.en: That’s what I’m going to call those moments from now on.
lines.zh: 从今往后，我就这么称呼那些时刻了。

lines.en: Is it really that hard for her to handle being complimented?
lines.zh: 被人夸一句，对她来说真有这么难吗？

lines.en: You’d think that by now she’d at least be able to dodge the word or brush it off but...nope.
lines.zh: 你会以为到了现在，她至少能躲开那个词或者一笑带过，可是……没有。

lines.en: It is what it is, though.
lines.zh: 不过，事情就是这样。

lines.en: The two of us wind up ordering coffee and a couple of sandwiches shortly after that.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我们俩点了咖啡和几个三明治。

lines.en: They come on rolls, so Karin does not need to go through the trouble of removing the crust from hers.
lines.zh: 三明治用的是圆面包卷，所以 Karin 不用费劲去切掉硬边。

lines.en: Once we finish eating, we say our goodbyes and part ways in front of the cafe.
lines.zh: 吃完后，我们在咖啡馆门前道了别，各自离开。

lines.en: I think I can hear her squeal to herself in joy as she runs off toward home.
lines.zh: 我好像听见她往家跑的时候，一个人开心得尖叫起来。
